text:
Code reviews are a vital practice in software development. They involve having another developer examine your code for mistakes before it is merged into the main project. This process is excellent for catching bugs early, which is much cheaper and faster to fix than discovering them after release.

Beyond finding errors, code reviews promote knowledge sharing. By reading each other's work, team members learn new techniques and understand different parts of the codebase. This reduces dependency on a single person. Ultimately, regular reviews build a culture of collaboration and accountability, significantly improving the overall quality of the team's work.
